name: ARE 4215
title: Sustainable Business Planning
description: The practice of creating a sustainable business plan as a critical step for entrepreneurial success. In this class you will learn principles of marketing, financial and human resource management as well as budgeting techniques and the legal and organizational structure of businesses while creating a sustainable business plan.
requirement_description: ARE 2210 and ARE 2215 or equivalent courses only with instructor's consent. Open to Juniors and Seniors. Not open for credit to students who have passed ARE 5215.
